_help: Copy to results.json and fill EVERY null with your real figures. One entry per full-pipeline brief (01 and 02). passed = did it meet the pass criteria. turns = turn counts per role from the transcripts. hit_cap = roles that stopped because they hit their maxTurns. cost = total cost in whatever unit you track (e.g. dollars). minutes = wall-clock time for both parts. For a failed run you may leave the numbers null.
